description: H3A read-only service capability/schedule/provision/use/loss typology. This file is a semantic dictionary, not a runtime catalog: it is never passed to the material catalog loader and never replaces the frozen intermediate8_v1 or f2_v1 axes.

axes.activity_axis: network.activity_kind (P productive organizations plus R plot activities)
axes.service_selection: commodity_spec(commodity_id).stockable == false, iterated in network.commodity_ids order

service_commodity_fields.unit: commodity_spec(commodity_id).unit; never summed across commodity ids
service_commodity_fields.capacity: nominal quarterly capability: organization activities use opening.organization_capacity, plot activities use network.activity_capacity, then B.T @ capacity summed by cell_commodity
service_commodity_fields.provided: B.T @ flows.activity_realized summed by cell_commodity (gross provision, not net of same-quarter pool credit)
service_commodity_fields.opening: sum of opening.stock_value over service cells of the commodity
service_commodity_fields.used_productive: flows.used on K demand rows, mapped through demand_input_index and input_cell, summed once per K row
service_commodity_fields.used_logistics: flows.edge_service_used attributed through network.edge_transport_service_cell; never through edge_commodity
service_commodity_fields.used_household: flows.edge_delivered on RoutePurpose.HOUSEHOLD boundary edges, summed by source cell commodity
service_commodity_fields.used_other: flows.second_input_used on service cells plus INVESTMENT actual use plus HOUSING boundary delivery; mutually exclusive with K/household/export paths
service_commodity_fields.lost: sum of invariant_summary.expired_leftover_by_cell over service cells of the commodity; never inferred from provided - used
service_commodity_fields.closing: sum of state.stock_value over service cells of the commodity
service_commodity_fields.balance_residual: opening + provided + imports - (used_productive + used_logistics + used_household + used_other + exports + lost + closing)

service_input_fields.activity_index: P-axis activity that produces at least one non-stockable service through network.B
service_input_fields.input_index: K-axis production input row in network.A
service_input_fields.used: flows.used on the K row's unique demand cell (real fuel/other input units; no posterior allocation)

housing_fields.formal_completed: flows.delivered on the region's RoutePurpose.HOUSING boundary demand cell
housing_fields.private_completed: sum of state.household_weight * flows.private_completed over the region's households
housing_fields.allocated: sum of state.household_weight * flows.housing_allocated over the region's households; an assignment of existing dwellings, never a new completion

units.service_commodities: commodity-specific declared unit; no cross-commodity sum or ratio
units.service_inputs: the input commodity's declared unit; service output and input units never add directly
units.housing: dwelling_unit, independent from every quarterly service commodity
units.legacy_expired_services: old scalar sink, reported unchanged and never used as a scientific aggregate

zero_and_missing.declared_nonstockable_without_cells: ResearchGateError: missing source/cell is not a legitimate empty measurement
zero_and_missing.unknown_commodity: ConfigError from the frozen commodity registry
zero_and_missing.negative_capacity_or_sink: ResearchGateError beyond ATOL; no max(0, ...) clipping
zero_and_missing.dust: differences inside tolerance_for (ATOL=1e-9, RTOL=1e-10) are retained raw
zero_and_missing.clock: opening.completed_ticks == flows.tick == state.completed_ticks; measured after the gate and before the clock advance

conservation.service_identity: opening + provided + imports = used_productive + used_logistics + used_household + used_other + exports + lost + closing
conservation.expiry_authority: lost sums invariant_summary.expired_leftover_by_cell and must reconcile with flows.expired_services

legacy_expiry.flows.expired_services: per-tick scalar applied by the kernel; recorded as legacy_expired_services
legacy_expiry.rule: the new lost field does not replace, rescale or relabel any legacy expiry denominator or gate

scope.writes: none (no state, flows, clock, disk or calibration mutation)
